t: Connectivity Test Runner - public implementations survey
title: Connectivity Test Runner - public implementations survey
definition: Checks whether configured endpoints are reachable as intended.
description:
Connectivity Test Runner is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Checks whether configured endpoints are reachable as intended. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Connectivity Test Runner. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Connectivity Test Runner. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Connectivity Test Runner capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.
